_comment: Machine-readable brand kit. Source: 'Real Skin Care Brand Kit.pdf' (4pp, supplied 2026-07-29). Consumed by scripts/klaviyo-email-audit.mjs and by marketing-email-design-production. Human-readable companion: data/brand/brand-kit.md

black.role: primary — logo, headlines, body text, primary button fill
black.notes: The logo is supplied in solid black only.

sand.role: warm neutral — section backgrounds, blocks, the leaf flourish either side of headings
sand.notes: The brand's only warm tone. Does the work a plain white background cannot.
sand.conflict: The sand LOGO is #ECE5D8; the palette says #EDE5D8. One digit apart and visually identical, but it is exactly the class of near-miss the email audit flags. Standardise on one.

green.role: accent — the leaf mark, sub-headings, highlights
green.notes: Use sparingly: one accent element per email or page. Not a background fill.
green.decision: #AEDEAC is THE brand green as of 2026-07-30. It supersedes #C1DF6D from the brand kit PDF, which is retired and must not be used. The supplied logo files carry export drift (#AFD9AC in PNG, #B0D9AC in SVG) off this value; the owner accepted that drift — do not re-export or re-upload for it.

superseded.source: Real Skin Care Brand Kit.pdf p3

grey.role: cool neutral — dividers, subtle panels, shadow bases

typography._comment: The brand kit PDF specifies Mont. The LIVE SITE does not use it — realskincare.com serves Cabin for headings and Outfit for body from Shopify's font CDN (verified 2026-07-30 from --font-heading-family / --font-body-family). Email follows the site, not the PDF, because cohesion is site-to-inbox.

site.heading: Cabin
site.source: realskincare.com CSS variables, served via fonts.shopifycdn.com

pdf_specified.status: not in use on the live site; retained here as a record of the identity document, not as the email or web rule

email_stacks.heading: Cabin, 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif
email_stacks.rationale: Name the real site font first — it renders in Apple Mail and iOS Mail, a large share of opens. Then fall back to the closest widely-installed face. Cabin is a humanist sans, so Trebuchet MS is the nearest universally-installed match and keeps some character in headings. Outfit is geometric with a tall x-height and has no true web-safe equivalent, so body falls to Helvetica/Arial, which is neutral and most legible at small sizes. Keeping different fallbacks preserves the heading/body distinction even when web fonts are stripped.
email_stacks.single_biggest_fix: All 22 live emails currently lead with 'Georgia, serif'. Moving from a serif to any of these sans stacks is the largest single cohesion gain available, before any colour work.

logo.wordmark: 'real' in an italic high-contrast serif with a leaf-shaped counter replacing the stem terminal of the r, above 'SKIN CARE' in widely letterspaced sans caps
logo.monogram: the lowercase 'r' with its leaf terminal, used standalone
logo.expected_path: data/brand/logo/ — see the README there for filenames
logo.hosting_note: Klaviyo templates reference images by URL, so these must be uploaded to Klaviyo or the Shopify CDN and the URLs recorded here before any template can use them.
logo.open_question: The supplied green colorway reads as a softer sage than palette green #C1DF6D. Sample the file and reconcile before use.

colorway_hexes_as_supplied.black: no fill declared — relies on the SVG default (black). Inlining into a context that sets `fill` will recolour it.
colorway_hexes_as_supplied.green: #B0D9AC in the SVG, #AFD9AC in the PNG — both drifted from the #AEDEAC Illustrator source

cleanup_applied: Every supplied SVG wrapped its artwork in <a xlink:href="49.7243137254902"> — an Illustrator export artifact. 55 anchors across 10 files. Inlined in HTML or email that makes the logo a link to a nonsense relative URL, i.e. a guaranteed 404. Stripped; artwork verified intact afterwards by alpha-channel variance.
rsc-logo.grey.svg renamed to rsc-logo-grey.svg (dot -> dash, matching every other file).
logo.cdn_note: PNG only. Klaviyo templates reference these by URL, and email clients do not render SVG — Gmail strips it, Outlook ignores it. The SVGs stay in the repo for web and print. Uploaded via scripts/upload-brand-logos.mjs; verified 10/10 serving 200 image/png, and the first upload confirmed pixel-identical to its local source.

design_elements: thin single hairline rule (black, hairline weight)
green leaf shape (echoes the logo's r terminal)
wooden circular podium / riser for product shots

email_rules._comment: Not from the PDF — derived from the brand kit plus marketing-email-design-production. The PDF is a visual identity document and says nothing about email.
email_rules.headline: Cabin (falling back to Trebuchet MS), #000000
email_rules.accent_use: #AEDEAC for one element per email maximum — a rule, a leaf, or a single highlighted phrase. Not for button fills or backgrounds.
off_brand_signals: any serif body stack — Georgia in particular, which all 22 live emails currently use
#C1DF6D — the retired green; its presence means something was built from the old PDF palette
Inter, Roboto, or system-only font stacks
#AEDEAC used as a large background fill
more than one accent colour in a single email

dark_mode.problem: Apple Mail, Outlook and Gmail invert light backgrounds in dark mode. A black logo on a white block then sits on a dark background — it either disappears or gets boxed in an auto-generated white patch. None of the 22 live emails handle this today.
dark_mode.rule: Serve the black wordmark by default and swap to the white colorway under prefers-color-scheme: dark. Both are hosted, so this is a CSS block, not new artwork.
dark_mode.caveat: Gmail ignores prefers-color-scheme and applies its own inversion, which it will not always apply to images. The sand block (#EDE5D8) is the safer default background for any section carrying the logo — it survives inversion better than pure white and keeps the black mark legible.

gaps: No transparent-background product images catalogued. Not blocking the eight live FLOWS, which pull product imagery dynamically through Klaviyo's Shopify blocks — it blocks designed promo campaigns only.
No layout exemplars; per marketing-email-design-production's own fit note, competitor reference emails substitute.
Sand is #ECE5D8 in the logo files vs #EDE5D8 in the palette. Imperceptible; fold in only if the files are ever re-exported for another reason.
Mont (identity PDF) vs Cabin/Outfit (live site). Resolved for email — the site wins — but the two documents still disagree.
postal_address: 1623 Central Ave STE 201, Cheyenne, WY 82001, United States
postal_address_note: CAN-SPAM footer address. Not a manufacturing location — products are made in the USA and no city or state is ever named as the place of manufacture. Replaced 6212 FM 933, Blum, TX 76627 on 2026-07-31.
free_shipping_threshold_note: Free-shipping order minimum, in USD. Appears in six emails' copy — always interpolate, never retype. Raised from 50 to 45 on 2026-07-31.
